import type { FileUploadContract, FileRecord } from '@unofficial-krds/contracts';
export interface FileUploadProps extends FileUploadContract {
    variant?: 'button' | 'dropzone';
}
/** Append one enabled committed store. The ephemeral chooser is deliberately unnamed, so unrelated same-name native fields and other uploaders remain intact. */
export declare function appendFileUploadFormData(data: FormData, name: string, files: readonly FileRecord[], disabled?: boolean): FormData;
export declare function FileUpload({ files, name, label, multiple, accept, maxFiles, maxBytes, disabled, onFilesChange, onFilesRejected, variant }: FileUploadProps): import("react").JSX.Element;
